arguments.text: Burnley are slight favourites to beat Everton at home, with the model assigning them a 38% probability of victory compared to Everton's 28%, though a draw is also plausible at 34%. The standout feature of this matchup is its expected low-scoring nature, with expected goals of just 0.94 for Burnley and 0.81 for Everton, and the most likely result a goalless draw at 17%. Under 2.5 goals dominates the model's assessment at 71%, with both teams to score just a 31% probability.
